issues.failure_explanation: The Armijo decrease is quadratic in ||V_{X_{underline r}}||. The proved lower bound gives ||V||^2 >= (1/4)||grad f(underline X)||^2 prod_k (r_k-underline r_k)/min{n_k,n_{-k}}, but the displayed decrease and the definition of delta use only the first power ||grad f(underline X)|| prod_k (...). For a nonstationary rank-deficient point with ||grad f(underline X)|| < 1, delta is too large by a factor ||grad f(underline X)||, so the final f(X)+2delta-3delta step is not justified.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redefine delta in Case 2 with ||grad f(underline X)||^2 rather than ||grad f(underline X)||, keeping the same constants; this matches the quadratic lower bound and the Case 3 scaling.
issues.overall_effect: The uniform one-step decrease in Case 2 of prop: GRAP-R decrease is unproved for rank-deficient accumulation points with small gradient, and thm: GRAP-R inherits the gap.

issues.failure_explanation: The candidate rank is breve r_k = min{r_k-1, rank(x_(k))}, which may be strictly larger than underline r_k when a nearby point has several singular values below Delta. The inequality from eq: inequality applied at X_{breve r} gives the product over k in I of (r_k - breve r_k)/min{n_k,n_{-k}}, not c_I = prod_{k in I}(r_k-underline r_k)/min{n_k,n_{-k}}. Since breve r_k >= underline r_k, the displayed lower bound with sqrt(c_I) is stronger than what the cited inequality implies.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must bound the decrease using the actual candidate ranks breve r_k, equivalently replace c_I by prod_{k in I}(r_k-breve r_k)/min{n_k,n_{-k}} and prove the resulting one-step decrease still dominates a uniform delta, or enlarge the rfGRAP-R index sets so underline r is a candidate, which sacrifices the advertised single-singular-value mechanism.
issues.overall_effect: The uniform one-step decrease for rank-deficient accumulation points is unproved for rfGRAP-R precisely when nearby iterates have more than one extra small singular value in a deficient mode; thm:added-1's apocalypse-free claim for rfGRAP-R is unreliable.
